# v4.0.0 — Module 4: Internal Operations and Inventory

Module 4 adds the Pinehaven Motion Systems learning environment across planning operations, capacity and production activity control, inventory, and performance/continuous improvement.

## Included

- 51 topic lessons across four sections
- 51 original SVG decision visuals
- 15 fictional CSV datasets
- 126 independently authored knowledge checks
- Internal operations and inventory formula sheet
- Pinehaven Q3 Operations Stabilization capstone and worked solution

## Release controls

The module was built from a source-coverage blueprint, locked calculation/data layer, and raster-reviewed visual layer before lesson generation. The pre-release audit independently checked calculations, links, source separation, visual integrity, assessment rationales, and originality controls. Private source-working files are not included in the public repository.
